title: Uniqueness of the Classical Langton Ant Highway Under Its Standard Wake
description: The complete twelve-class standard wake and full drift (2,-2) determine the classical Langton ant highway uniquely. An exact integer potential bounds all candidate periods, and exhaustive ordered-event reconstruction leaves the standard period-104 read word as the sole normalized realization. The revision also retains general wake-dependent period bounds and terminating inverse synthesis for non-axis drift. Self-contained source code reconstructs and checks the certificates with exact integer arithmetic.
